native_trace.admission: Inspected actual Map::AddToMap<GameObject>: already-present objects refresh visibility; otherwise it computes a cell, retains an ASSERT for invalid cells and an error/false branch before grid insertion, then adds to grid/world/active/static-transport collections and visibility. GameObject::Create already checks position. No production map rejection is injected here and no assertion is removed. native_trace.world_summon: Preserve template/create/scope validation, phases, summoner GUID, transport attachment, respawn, owner-before-insertion and personal viewers. Player-owned and zero-lifetime creature-owned GOs enter Unit::m_gameObj before insertion; timed creature-created weapons remain independent. SetTratsport adds a passenger before insertion for correct initial client display, so deleting a rejected GO without cleanup would leave cross-references. Moving ownership after insertion would also change first visibility and is deliberately avoided.
native_trace.cleanup: Use canonical virtual CleanupsBeforeDelete, then delete, then return nullptr on false insertion, with an explicit map/entry/position error. GameObject cleanup calls WorldObject cleanup and RemoveFromOwner; owner lookup uses the retained map even though the rejected GO is not in-world, then native Unit::RemoveGameObject(false) clears only its owner-list/slot entry. WorldObject cleanup clears phases/personal references and detaches the passenger. StaticTransport derives through Transport and its actual primary WorldObject vtable dispatches Transport::CleanupsBeforeDelete, unloading static passengers/removing dynamic passengers before GameObject cleanup. Native destructors assert empty passenger sets; no ordinary success behavior, checks or existing diagnostics are suppressed.
native_trace.callers: SmartAI's existing opt-in action50 retry now receives null after rejected insertion and retains its pending root without dependent LINK/death. Native success still returns the same allocation. Reviewed local MapScripts and battleground/PvP callers already have nullable creation contracts; no blanket script rewrite or quest/loot/credit grant is added. Other unflagged SmartAI callers retain their existing no-retry behavior. Map-level callers receive the same corrected failure contract without a fabricated Unit owner.
